meta.title: Hotel Arc en Ciel | Eze Village, French Riviera
meta.description: Welcome to Hotel Arc en Ciel, located at the foot of the enchanting medieval village of Eze, between Nice and Monaco. Air-conditioned rooms with sea and mountain views.

home.hero_subtitle: Between land and sea, a haven of peace at the foot of one of the most beautiful villages in France.
home.intro_text: Ideally situated on the middle corniche between Nice (8 Kms) and Monaco (6 Kms), Eze Village, a magical place planted in the azure, has preserved a special atmosphere of authenticity and tradition. The Hotel Arc en ciel is located at the foot of this village, one of the most beautiful in France. This establishment also features a bar (snack food) and a souvenir gift shop.

eze_section.title: Discover Eze Village
eze_section.text: An enchanting medieval village, Eze is an ideal holiday destination between Nice and Monaco. Perched at an altitude of 429 meters, it offers exceptional sea views. A perfect stopover that allows you to discover this sunny and picturesque town on foot.

rooms.title: Our Rooms
rooms.description: The simplicity of this small hotel, located at the entrance of the village, will delight you and offer a restful break, far from the tumult of the Riviera. Air-conditioned, bright rooms with all comforts (TV, free WiFi, shower, toilet).

items.name: Standard Double Room
items.description: Bright room ideal for a couple's stay, equipped with a large bed, air conditioning, and free Wi-Fi.

items.name: Superior Room
items.description: Spacious room with an unobstructed view, offering optimal comfort for your stay on the French Riviera.

location.title: Access
location.description: Between land and sea, with easy access: A8 motorway exit 57, La Turbie, head towards Eze village. The hotel is close to the tourist office.
